Have control. Let loose.
The WRX has all the hardware needed to corner with grace and speed.
Starting with the suspension, it’s an enviable setup—a rigid unibody
chassis with reinforced suspension mounting points, aluminum front
lower control arms with pillow-ball joint mounts, and a double wishbone
Cornering rear suspension architecture with pillow-ball joint bushings. And with
Subaru Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive and Active Torque Vectoring,
the WRX offers an almost endless supply of traction.
Having excellent grip is only half of the handling equation. The other
is the driver’s sense of control and precision, which the WRX delivers,
thanks to its quick 14.4:1 steering ratio.1 Available 18-inch wheels,2
inverted front struts,2 and Brembo® performance brakes3 further
Responsiveness
heighten its response and sharpen its focus.

turbocharged SUBARU BOXER® engine, where power is generated
smoothly, efficiently and instantaneously, thanks to its twin-scroll
turbocharger. Matched with the 6-speed manual transmission or the

Mundane undone.
The WRX STI is laser-focused on handling, with a track-tuned suspension
that features standard inverted front struts and aluminum front lower
control arms for low unsprung weight—an attribute further enhanced by
its lightweight 19-inch alloy wheels. And it’s all underpinned by Subaru
Cornering Symmetrical AWD with Driver Controlled Center Differential, front and rear
limited-slip differentials and Active Torque Vectoring, so you can hit your
apexes and nail your exits with control, precision and speed.
In the WRX STI, the synergy between driver and car is unmistakable.
You’ll feel an invigorating sense of control, thanks to its ultra-quick
13.3:1 steering ratio and rigid unibody chassis. Its powerful Brembo®
high-performance braking system features 6-piston front and 2-piston
rear monoblock calipers and cross-drilled rotors to stop you with
Responsiveness
authority and reduced brake fade. And the signature rear wing of
the WRX STI adds downforce for more stability at higher speeds.
It’s a potent, race-proven2 package—a 310-hp 2.5-liter turbocharged
SUBARU BOXER® engine, featuring a high-flow air intake and performance
exhaust system. It’s coupled with a precise and durable 6-speed, close-ratio
transmission and SI-DRIVE for on-the-fly performance adjustments. This
Power
puts all the power and torque of the WRX STI right into your hands.

enhancing performance but the ability to keep performing, lap after
lap. This approach to engineering results in vehicles that are more

communicative, responsive, and able to take the sustained punishment
that high-intensity driving demands.
